profile.role_note: Free main character in Electro form; Hsin's best Electro Flare battery.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free unit — switch your Rover to Electro and build them as Hsin's best Electro Flare battery; no pull needed.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Blazing Brilliance (or Emerald of Genesis) + 5-piece Flash of Electric Reflection in Hsin Electro Flare teams (Reminiscence: Suhsin the Inevitable in the main slot), or 5-piece Moonlit Clouds elsewhere (Impermanence Heron). Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and 120% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: Changli's signature, but Game8's and Sportskeeda's top pick for Electro Rover: 12% ATK and Resonance Skill DMG buffs. Not their signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Best F2P option; Energy Regen plus stacking ATK% on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate and Basic Attack synergy; usable 5-star.

echo_sets.name: Flash of Electric Reflection
echo_sets.note: Made for Electro Rover's Electro Flare kit: inflicting Flare grants Electro DMG, and Outro grants the incoming Resonator 25% Electro DMG. The set for Hsin's Electro Flare team.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Best option in any non-Flare team: Energy Regen plus an ATK buff for the incoming Resonator on Outro.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: If Rover is played as the main DPS rather than a sub-DPS battery.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for their sub-DPS damage.

teams.name: Premium: Hsin + Electro Rover + Suisui

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Electro Flare hypercarry; unique Intro interaction grants both her and Rover Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Bulk Electro Flare applicator; funnels ATK and All-DMG amp to Hsin. Free 5-star.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Raises Flare and Rage stack caps; heals and amplifies team damage.

teams.rotation: Suisui opens with her buff sequence, Rover applies Flare stacks with skill and Basics then Liberation into the Intro interaction, and Hsin detonates stacks with her Liberation. Aim for ~120% Energy Regen on Rover.

teams.name: Budget: Hsin + Electro Rover + Buling

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Same Flare-detonation carry; don't swap-cancel her Resonance Skill mid-cast.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Same Flare-stack engine with the Intro interaction bonus.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Free 4-star sustain; applies Flare herself and buffs Resonance Skill DMG.

teams.rotation: Same Electro Flare loop as the Suisui version: Buling opens with the first Flare stacks, Rover piles on more and triggers the Intro interaction, then Hsin builds and detonates with her Liberation.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Shot up the ranks in 3.7 as Hsin's best Electro Flare battery.

sources.record: Flash of Electric Reflection Sonata Effect

sequences.verdict: Partially verified: all six nodes are official and two aggregators agree on effects, but sources disagree on priorities. S2 (Electro Flare on Liberation) is the only broadly endorsed node; treat the rest as incremental.

pull_path.why: Full kit free; the Hsin Electro Flare hybrid role works at S0.
Liberation applies 5 Electro Flare stacks - the standout node both sources endorse.
+20% multiplier on Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics.
+20% multiplier on Thrum of All Sounds and Thunder Bane; everything is free anyway.
